nominal_voltage_class.notes: Toyota chief engineer (via InsideEVs): bZ "still runs on a 400-volt electrical architecture". Autopian: pack 391 V.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Toyota Canada release lists 77 kWh for XLE AWD and Limited AWD (total, usable not stated). US release says 74.7 kWh for the same trims; NRCan ranges match US EPA ranges, so probably the same pack stated differently.
Toyota USA release: 74.7 kWh total capacity for XLE AWD and Limited AWD. Conflicts with Toyota Canada 77 kWh.

chemistry.notes: Autopian (chief engineer interview): "The larger pack retains the same chemistry and cells as the previous version" (NMC). GreenCars: "still has nickel-manganese-cobalt cathodes". Relayed by press.

dc_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs relays Toyota: bZ charging "capped at 150 kilowatts". Model-level, not stated per pack.
